after.zh: 同一个想法换一个方向。横着平均抹平左右的毛刺，竖着平均抹平上下的。
after.en: The same idea in another direction. Averaging across smooths out spikes from side to side; averaging down smooths them from top to bottom.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref>的三点平均只看左右。噪点和毛刺可不只在横着的方向上。
t.en: The three-point average from <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref> only looks left and right. Noise and specks are not only spread out sideways.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：每一格换成它自己和上下两个邻居的平均。
t.en: Your task in this level: replace each cell with the average of itself and its neighbours above and below.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：方块的上下两条边多出一圈灰
caption.en: Set 1: the square's top and bottom edges gain a grey band

brief.zh: 每个像素换成它和上下两个邻居的平均。
brief.en: Replace each pixel with the average of itself and its neighbours above and below.
